children: Anixa Biosciences Inc reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss as it continued development work on its oncology vaccine programs and reported no revenue for the quarter. The company posted a net loss attributable to common shareholders of $(2.61M) and diluted loss per share of $(0.08); revenue was $0 for the quarter, unchanged from the year-ago period.
Revenue was $0 for 3Q 2026, unchanged from $0 in the year-ago quarter.
Net income was a loss of $(2.61M) for 3Q 2026, versus a loss of $(2.26M) in 3Q 2025 (worsened YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(0.08) for 3Q 2026, versus $(0.07) in the year-ago quarter.
No revenue reported for the quarter or year-to-date; company remains focused on licensing therapeutics and vaccines for future commercialization.
Research and development spending increased with emphasis on a breast cancer vaccine program; R&D totaled roughly $1.33M in the quarter and $3.69M year-to-date, with shifts across specific programs.

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were approximately $13.9M; management expects existing funding to be sufficient for more than 12 months and executed an at-the-market equity offering to bolster liquidity.
Company continues to rely on third-party collaborators (CMOs/CROs) to advance preclinical and clinical work while conserving capital.
Near-term revenue is not anticipated; the outlook centers on achieving clinical milestones and licensing outcomes tied to clinical success.
